purpose: Document first-party Sudan land-registry and bounded anonymous parcel-service review for Kassala.
assessment: Sudan's Judiciary land-registration administration, Sudan Survey Authority, and National Information Center spatial-portal project are first-party national leads. The reviewed pages and current Aqari landing page do not expose a Kassala parcel viewer, concrete WMS/WFS URL, parcel schema/CRS, or anonymous native-ID-plus-geometry response. The failed exact public endpoint probes are not evidence of citywide absence.
registryAssessment: A national land-registration and surveying custodian is evidenced, but a Kassala-specific local registry or public parcel service is not sufficiently evidenced; registryFound remains null.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Judiciary page describes the General Land Registrations Administration, branch offices, and survey/registration procedures; no Kassala parcel API is published.
Sudan Survey Authority country report identifies SSA as the official surveying and mapping authority and describes national basemap work; it does not provide an open Kassala parcel layer.
Official NIC page describes a national spatial portal and mentions OGC WMS/WFS, without a concrete endpoint or public parcel schema.
Aqari landing page describes Judiciary real-estate services; public JavaScript references user/service routes but no anonymous Kassala map layer.
